主要内容: ROYAL BANK OF CANADA reported that dollar denominated accounts for the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Canada (the Iranian Embassy) are frozen by Ontario court order in connection with civil litigation. In fiscal 2019, these accounts generated less than $3,000 in gross revenue and less than $3,000 in net income. The report was filed on December 4, 2019, and signed by David I. McKay, President and Chief Executive Officer.
